reason: The first run used WorldPop R2025A constrained population cells, which can omit rural and low-density residential areas.

The first run's altitude status logic incorrectly marked a county pending when one queried inhabited cell was already at or below 2,000m but other candidate sample points were intentionally not queried.
The first run's sunshine maximum did not yet use every positive-population cell and its coverage threshold was less conservative.
use_guard: Do not use R1_REMAINING.csv or R1_EXCLUDED.csv from the preliminary run as the input to R2. Wait for the active recalculation to complete.
